messages:
nisha_cs: FYI customer (ClearHealth) found a reproducible issue in Private deployment (v1.8.2) where short multi-turn sessions sometimes return a duplicated final token and a truncated last sentence. They provided repro steps and logs, pasted below. filing to eng for triage - priority request from AE.

nisha_cs: Repro steps from customer: 
1) Start session with session_id=ch-xyz
2) Send prompt A -> get reply ok
3) Send followup B immediately (within 80ms)
4) Final reply sometimes ends with duplicated last token ("support") and cuts next sentence. Happens ~1/15 requests under their load.

nisha_cs: Minimal curl they used:

```
curl -X POST \
  https://private.redwood.example/api/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.3-q","session_id":"ch-xyz","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"A"},{"role":"user","content":"B"}],"max_tokens":128,"stream":false}'
```

nisha_cs: Expected: coherent final sentence. Actual: sometimes ends like: "We will escalate to support support" and truncation of following sentence. They attached server logs showing KV cache hit then a small prefetch hitch. Snip of relevant logs:

```
[t=2025-04-22T14:11:09Z] session=ch-xyz model=redwood-1.3-q kvcache=hit prefetch_ms=2
[t=2025-04-22T14:11:09Z] session=ch-xyz seq=34 token="support" emit_ms=12
[t=2025-04-22T14:11:09Z] session=ch-xyz seq=35 token="support" emit_ms=3
[t=2025-04-22T14:11:09Z] session=ch-xyz final_truncated=true
```

nisha_cs: Customer says they can reproduce reliably when ramping to 300 rps with low inter-message latency. They asked if this is a prompt-history merging issue or serving runtime bug.

ryan_se: thanks Nisha, adding logs to the ticket. linking customer case #CH-8912. do we need any extra info from them?

nisha_cs: They can run a custom script if we want more traces. Also willing to run a build with extra debug flags.

devon_eng: looking at logs quick: double "support" at seq 34/35 looks like off-by-one in streaming flush or a duplicate token emission after prefetch. could be related to recent prefetch patch (PR 4782). I'll try to repro locally with their minimal curl. can you drop the exact model config (quant, kvcache settings) the customer uses?

nisha_cs: Model config: redwood-1.3-q, int8-quant, kvcache=enabled, prefetch=on (default), batch_mode=continuous. I copied the customer's full output to the ticket.

devon_eng: confirmed repro on a local private deploy (approx same q config) when I hammer with inter-message delays <100ms. I can reproduce ~1/20. Steps: run a small loop sending two messages per session rapidly. got duplicated token at end. Suspect race between prefix/KV cache restore and next-token emission when prefetch triggers.

devon_eng: temporary workaround: set prefetch=false or increase inter-message throttle. can someone confirm we can surface this to customer as interim mitigation?

sam_prod: impact? how many customers on private deploy likely to hit this pattern? is hosted affected? priority candidate P1?

devon_eng: hosted runtime uses slightly different prefetch path; I haven't seen reports there. Private with continuous batching + prefetch seems affected. Likely minority of sessions but could be severe for chat consistency. I'd tag P2 -> P1 if customer is blocked.

ryan_se: customer says it's affecting their user-facing chat in prod, and their launch next week depends on fixing. they've asked for patch timeline.

devon_eng: will open internal bug GH#6127 and attach repro script + logs. ETA for a fix: investigate immediate patch (1-2d) to add a guard dedupe on final token emission, full fix in next runtime release (1-2 weeks). I'll post PRs.

devon_eng: quick local note (cmd I ran):
```
for i in {1..1000}; do 
  curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer x" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-1.3-q","session_id":"test-'$i'","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"},{"role":"user","content":"followup"}],"max_tokens":64}' https://localhost:8443/api/v1/generate &
done
```

ryan_se: added GH#6127 link to case CH-8912 and flagged AE. Customer asked to be notified for test build. Nisha can you coordinate test build with them?

nisha_cs: Yep — I'll ask if they want a nightly with the dedupe guard or prefer prefetch toggle. I'll push update to the case and get their acceptance test script.

devon_eng: tagging @deploy-bot to queue a debug nightly if we want quick validation (non-prod image).

deploy-bot: queued nightly image redwood/runtime:nightly-20250423-debug for private envs. link: https://ci.local/build/7890 :robot_face:

sam_prod: thanks all — will mark product cluster for follow-up in roadmap board and capture rollout criteria: reproduction reduced to <1/10000, unit test for prefix restore race, and telemetry to detect duplicate-token events.

nisha_cs: Customer happier with nightly + prefetch toggle option. I'll coordinate test patch and report back. :thumbsup:

ryan_se: great, setting case to "pending eng test". will update if customer confirms nightly reproduces fix.

nisha_cs: (reaction) :white_check_mark:
